core_obligations: Reduction: Coh rules agree with the QCoh prescriptions in remark-QCoh-abelian; by coherent-Noetherian it suffices to check coherence on U_etale for a smooth surjection (proof lines 3906-3913).
Coker and Im: the exact functor f^*(-)|_{U_etale} sends them to cokernel/image of a map of coherent O_U-modules, hence coherent (proof lines 3914-3917).

Q(Ker): the restriction kills parasitic modules (lemma-parasitic), and f^*Q(Ker)| = f^*Ker| by adjoint-kernel-parasitic (2), so Q(Ker) is coherent and is the kernel in Coh; inclusion Coh -> QCoh exact (proof lines 3918-3922).
proof_roadmap: Reduce coherence checks to a smooth presentation.
Handle cokernel, image and Q of kernel through exactness and parasitic killing.
difficulty_reason: Reduces to the QCoh kernel/cokernel prescriptions of the abelian remark, then checks coherence after restriction to a smooth presentation: the exact restriction functor preserves cokernels and images of maps between coherent modules, kills parasitic modules, and the adjunction defect identifies f^*Q(Ker) with f^*Ker.
